name: presentation_ops
description: Presentation operations for PowerPoint (.pptx) files: create, read, and edit decks. Uses python-pptx. Read-only operations never modify files; write operations require authorized=true plus confirm=true plus a policy allow rule. All file paths are resolved against the workspace root - nothing is written outside it.

operation.description: One of: create | read | edit | sources. Defaults to sources.

content.description: Slide content for create or edit (one slide per blank line).

authorized.description: Must be true for write operations (create, edit).

confirm.description: Must be true to actually write a file.

author: Stella
notes: Uses python-pptx. Write operations are destructive and need authorized=true + confirm=true + an allow rule. Paths are confined to the workspace root.
